name: atm_withdrawal
description: Release or hold a cash withdrawal at an ATM
subject: user
hold: Should the pending cash withdrawal be held because the account shows signs of being a money mule account, which receives money from other people and takes it out as cash?

typologies.mule: Money mule: the account receives money from other people and passes it on as cash
typologies.legit: Legitimate: the customer takes out their own money

reasons.new_account: The account was opened very recently
reasons.funds_in_then_cash_out: Money arrived from another person shortly before and is now taken out as cash
reasons.maximum_withdrawal: The withdrawal is at the daily limit
reasons.atm_flagged_concentration: The share of recent users of this ATM who carry a mule label is far above the normal share
reasons.atm_burst_of_new_accounts: Several new accounts used this ATM in the minutes before this withdrawal
reasons.customer_explained_in_advance: An earlier message from the customer explains the withdrawal
reasons.usual_pattern: The amount and the place match what the customer usually does
